doc.title: Janis Siegel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 22, 2015

title: Being a foodie and cooking with a friend
summary: She is a food blogger who cooks with a City College engineer friend who built her home studio.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: It’s funny you say that because you’re a food blogger, right?
Yes, if you insist, I am.
You had told me about some fellow who you cook with I think, last time you were here.

Yeah. Well he’s a friend and he’s a professor at City College of New York at Sonic Arts. He’s an engineer. And he was working on my little home studio putting it together and we started talking about food and one night we had a meal together and then we realized
wouldn’t it be fun to construct a meal together. So we started doing that. It’s hard to find time. And his wife bakes up a storm so we’ve got it all covered.
